name: Ama Ane Maid to Tsundere Iinchou no Ouen Ecchi ~Iyashimasu! Hagemashimasu! Hurray♪ Hurray♪ Tanezuke Ganbare♪~
original_name: 甘姉メイドとツンデレ委員長の応援エッチ ～癒します！励まします！フレー♪フレー♪種付けがんばれ♪～
source:
To live is hard... dash away such feelings with N/M/C's
200% sweet and soothing perk-up ecchi ADV novel!

"You" are a hikikomori with a tender maid who's close as a sister and a childhood friend who's totally tsundere. They give you "cheerleader sex" to boost your spirit!

In the tradition of adventure novels you'll get to help yourself to both beautiful girls. Each is a distinct personality: tender onesan maid, tsundere playmate chairperson.

Refresh with PE shorts & school swimwear, have a threesome on the girls' "dangerous day"!
